content.title: Alex Cooper calls out Alix Earle for 'passive-aggressive' behavior: 'I know what happened and so do you'
content.text: Alex Cooper; Alix Earle. Credit: Kevin Mazur/Getty; Phillip Faraone/Getty Alex Cooper is addressing Alix Earle amid a rumored feud between the podcast hosts. "There's no NDA, no one is stopping you, stop hiding behind other people and just say it yourself. What's the beef?" Cooper said in a TikTok video on April 13.Earle used to have a podcast called Hot Mess under Cooper’s Unwell Network, which was abruptly dropped from the lineup in February 2025. Alex Cooper is speaking out amid an alleged feud with Alix Earle. In a cryptic TikTok video shared by Cooper on April 13, Cooper claimed there was ongoing drama between the two. Earle used to have a podcast called Hot Mess under Cooper’s Unwell Network, which was abruptly dropped from the lineup in February 2025. "You guys know I don't usually address this kind of stuff because it feels like a waste of time and honestly it's embarrassing to participate in this, but I'm obviously seeing the videos, I'm getting tagged, I see the DMs, I see the comments. So at this point it just feels long overdue," Cooper began. "Alix Earle, hey girl," the Call Her Daddy host continued, addressing Earle head-on. "The passive-aggressive reposts and the likes and the commenting on things. I gotta call you out here. You're gonna need to get specific, and just say what you gotta say about me. There's no NDA, no one is stopping you, stop hiding behind other people and just say it yourself. What's the beef?" She continued, "I'm really tired of waking up and seeing you using this fake drama to distract from other s--- going online for you. Not interested. I know what happened and so do you, so talk. Unless the fake narrative you're creating happens to be way more interesting than the truth. I have nothing to hide when it comes to just you and me. "So, unless you actually have something to say, I'm out. This is over." Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter. Cooper concluded her message, telling her followers to "have a good Monday." Entertainment Weekly contacted Earle and did not receive an immediate response. Though it isn't clear what Cooper is referring to, Earle reposted a TikTok video earlier in April of thebravomom, another content creator, that put Cooper in an unfavorable light. "Like, you just had the most horrific accident of your life, you’re hanging on by a thread, don’t know if you’re gonna make it and she’s the first one there," thebravomom a.k.a Ashley Tiscareno said. “She’s the Grim Reaper. She wants to get the exclusive interview. She wants to be there when you’re vulnerable and broken down and you’re ready to sign over your rights to your life,” she added. Alex Cooper and Alix Earle in New York in September 2023. Gotham/GC Images After Earle's podcast was dropped from Cooper's Unwell Network, Earle posted about the shake-up on TikTok in March 2025. “Obviously, there’s been a lot of chatter online this week about me and work. And I also have no idea what’s going on,” Earle said in one video, before following up in another TikTok: “Don’t really want to get into the details of it all, and I kind of can’t get into the details of it all right now, but I’ve loved it so much, and I’m really proud of what I built with the podcast.” Cooper also addressed the situation in her Instagram Stories. “Hi I see ur comments,” she wrote at the time, per E!. “Alix not being able to podcast has nothing to do with Unwell. Idk why she can’t/what’s going on. Unwell gave her everything back she owns her IP.”
